zusammenfassung: This week is less about the next model showcase than about controllable work contexts. ChatGPT for Teens shows how text AI can encourage learning paths instead of shortcuts. ElevenLabs reduces subtitling to an editable production step, while Genie One ties answers to governance and company data. ChatPlayground makes contradictions visible, and Berd brings agents back closer to local projects and one's own rules.
highlights: ElevenLabs AI Caption Generator (9/10) and controllable AI contexts
Trend: from individual AI answers to bounded contexts, verifiable data flows and clear permissions
Shift: from all-in-one to specialised solutions
trend: Context, permissions, data flows and review loops become the real quality criterion of AI tools.
